market.question: Will Crude Oil (CL) hit (HIGH) $120 by end of June?

assessment.reasoning: WTI ~$104 needs +15% to hit $120 (1-min high) by end of June. Recent geopolitical-driven spike already touched ~$110; another bout of escalation in 60 days is plausible but not base case.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Iran/Strait of Hormuz developments and OPEC+ supply policy.
